burn: 2026-09 (second burn). Branches re-based on main 2026-09-09; the 2026-08 burn history is gone from coord/* by user decision.
ground_rules: Read .cursor/rules/swarm-coordination.mdc (incl. 'Lessons from the 2026-08 burn'), COORDINATION.md, and your OPEN_ISSUES entries before the first CLAIM.
Every task below has a kill criterion. When it fires: BLOCKED with the evidence, no further sweeps in that family; A1 reassigns.

Metric of record: tests/scenarios/synthetic/level_set_normal_path_sweep.py --seeds 0 1 2 3 4 (sample-level bg-aware ARI, bg recall, coverage, leaf counts). Baseline 2026-09-09: nulls 30/30, hierarchy 5/5 (5-6 of 6 fine leaves), linked_tori root K=2 5/5, nested root K=2 5/5 (2 leaves), bimodal_circle 2/5, two_gaussians_weak 2/5. Any change that lowers a null pass or a root K is a regression regardless of what else improves.

Acceptance-path code (level_set.py selection, recursion.py descent, controller.py scale search, evidence/*) changes land flag-gated with default off unless the task says otherwise; flipping a default needs the full 5-seed sweep in the DONE note.
Never weaken a test. @awaiting tests flip only on green evidence. One-off probes live in /tmp or are deleted before DONE.
Default pytest already deselects slow/real_data; tests/stage1 still takes ~50 min. Run the focused subset named in your task before DONE; A1 runs the broad suite on merge.
SI.tex is shared by section (see owns_files); edit only your sections, keep hunks local, and never restructure. paper.tex belongs to A6.

Apply REQUEST_TRACKER edits (OPEN_ISSUES current-only convention, logs append-only, stable numbering; next issue number is in the OPEN_ISSUES header). Keep queues 2-3 deep with information-priced tasks, each with a kill criterion. Record every kill decision in OPEN_ISSUES_LOG.

Fable analysis cadence: after roughly every 5th MERGE_DONE, or immediately when any worker fires a kill criterion, spawn ONE claude-fable-5-1-thinking-high subagent with SCRATCHPAD.json, the relevant OPEN_ISSUES entries, the latest sweep lines, and the DONE/BLOCKED notes since the last analysis; ask for: which families to kill, which to escalate, what the next 2-3 tasks per worker should be, and any spec/code divergence it sees. Apply its guidance via TASK_ASSIGN/TASK_REFILL; log the analysis summary in SCRATCHPAD_LOG.

queue.summary: Flag-gated separation-evidence guard in select_level_set_partition (default off, LevelSetConfig flag): when cross flow is 0 or below the ceiling, require that the absence of flow is supported by the hit counts on the boundary nodes (likelihood of observing zero cross transitions given the nodes' hit totals under a one-feature Poisson model), not by link existence alone. No new tuned constant: the threshold is a probability level tied to the existing DM margin or derived. Unit test on a synthetic 2-clump scaffold with controlled hit counts.
queue.kill: If the guard rejects any linked_tori / nested / two_gaussians_clear root accept on seeds 0-4, or accepts lone_gauss2d s17, it is wrong as designed; BLOCKED with the sweep lines.

queue.summary: DM overconfidence in the shot-noise regime: dm_partition_background_verdict returns logBF in the thousands on 200-500-sample regions at 3-8 hits/node. queue.kill: If the corrected logBF distributions of nulls and composites still overlap by more than 20% of reads, the DM is not usable as the evidence floor - say so and stop; do not tune a margin.

queue.summary: FadedMixture samples ~46-49% tissue regardless of tissue_fraction (density = sum w_c [lambda f_c + (1-lambda) u], u uniform on the box; tissue_fraction only pads the box). Add an honest tissue MASS fraction parameter (e.g. tissue_mass) that sets the actual expected background mass, keep the current behaviour as the default so no benchmark changes silently, make metadata report requested vs actual mass, and fix the misleading name/docstring. Unit test: sampled tissue fraction within +-3% of the requested mass at n=4000.

Re-run the normal-path sweep (seeds 0-4, level-set scenes) at tissue_mass in {0.05, 0.20, 0.46(current)} via a sweep flag, WITHOUT changing defaults. Report per scene: root K, leaves, bg-aware ARI, bg recall, coverage. The question: how much of the residual child over-splitting (nested 5 leaves on some seeds, bimodal 4) is tissue mass vs reader semantics.
queue.kill: If results at 0.05 tissue are no better than at 0.46 on nested/bimodal child counts, tissue mass is not the driver; NOTE that and stop - do not sweep more fractions.

queue.summary: Check the SI S14 calibration text that speaks of 'tissue fractions 0/0.05' as mass fractions: determine what those runs actually contained (box padding vs mass) and REQUEST_TRACKER the correction with exact numbers. Then re-baseline the @awaiting recovery expectations (#41, #26 scenario tests) on the repaired generators WITHOUT weakening topology criteria - only fix ground-truth counts that the generator repair changed; list every changed expectation in the DONE note.
